notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.58.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hey GOALS community,

0.58.0 brings a big focus on animation and smoother gameplay. From a new goalkeeper saving system to smarter AI and refined player movement, the pitch feel more dynamic and natural. You’ll also notice improvements to set pieces, tackling, and even the camera options. Here are some of the highlights:


Highlights:
New goalkeeper saving system

Added stepover skill move

Less aggressive lock-on for more natural control 

Movement updates: refined acceleration, smoother dribbling, pre-trap movement, and jockey nerfs 

Curve-based motion system for more natural stumbles, get-ups, and penalty run-ups

Blocking & tackling improvements including fixes, balance tweaks, and bone collision detection

Set piece upgrades with better free kick positioning and new wall behaviours

Smarter AI with improved movement, attacking/defensive logic, and signal animations

Updated camera option with adjusted height and zoom


New stepover skill move: 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/f317a3490aaee8d5b0be794d7432931af9d6d222.gif"]





Full patch notes details on our website.   (Coming soon)



Jump in, test it out, and let us know how it feels. We’re building this together, see you on the pitch!

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.57.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/yTbuolJ.png"]



This one’s for the tacticians! 

0.57.0 introduces new formations and the first iteration of player roles, with unique mentalities that shape how your team behaves on the pitch. 

There’s also been a lot of work under the hood: smarter AI, tighter controls, cleaner animations. The kind of stuff you feel more than see. 

Check out the latest on Alpha. 

Build GOALS with us.


Highlights:


Improved through passes, lofted pass/cross trajectories, and pass selection. 

Tuned movement, shooting, ball speed and skill moves. 

Tweaked second player press, call player short, interceptions, and open goal aim assist. 

Reworked blocking with new movement and animations. 

Faster stumbles, and tweaked shoulder barge.

Offensive and defensive AI is now more coordinated and positionally aware. 

Player roles added, with a set of special mentalities. 

Three new formations added. 

Tweaked gameplay cameras. 


Player Roles: 


[img src="https://i.imgur.com/70BOMWR.png"]



Full list of patch notes can be found on our website.



Jump in, test it out, and let us know how it feels. See you on the pitch!

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.56.3 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hey GOALS community,

Patch 0.56.3 is live! This update delivers smarter passing, more responsive controls, improved AI behavior, enhanced defensive mechanics, refined goalkeeping, deeper team tactics, and upgraded visuals for a better gameplay experience.


Highlights:
Improved long shot dispersion, ground pass targeting, through passes, and overall passing flow

Introduced distance-based lofted pass randomness for more accurate long through balls when receivers are open

Contextual through passes added for better decision making

Better pass selection, player switching, and triggered runs

Added agility system and refined sliding tackle collisions

Flick passes enabled for last-second decisions

First-time shots, low crosses, and stretch interceptions improved

Off-ball shoulder barges and skill move chain penalties added

New team tactics system

Goalkeepers: Better rush-outs, faster recovery, rebalanced saves, and fix for exaggerated kicks/throws when going backwards

AI: More natural behavior and better off-ball movement

Visual updates: character polish, lighting improvements, and new net physics


New team tactics system:
